topic: Data usage reporting for multiple devices
summary_markdown: A discussion arose regarding the availability of data usage metrics, specifically concerning EE data for a date range (06-11). It was noted that some data is available via 8017. A potential issue with Teltonika devices was suspected, as similar data was missing for Lithuania. The participants discussed the method for viewing data across multiple devices; it was confirmed that a report can be generated to view data across all devices simultaneously, rather than accessing them individually.
decisions: A ticket will be created regarding the data discrepancy.
action_items: Create a ticket to investigate missing EE data usage metrics (06-11) and potential Teltonika device glitch.
